title: A new Cities: Skylines Series: Franklin
premise: Donoteat announces Franklin using escalating title cards that promise a Cities: Skylines series across time, education and entertainment, then reveal the series name, creator credit and June 23 arrival date. These are promotional claims, not independently verified historical assertions or a narrated city plot.
coverage: Inspected all 9 indexed frames on visual/Vln5Ri4Zpgo/sheet-0001.jpg (the only sheet), sampled at the first available frame of each 5-second bin with additional scene-score >0.30 selection enabled; no additional scene-threshold frames occur here. Inspected 20 native-resolution targeted stills at 0, 1, 2, 4.5, 7, 8, 10, 12, 13, 15, 17, 20, 23, 25, 30, 33, 35, 37, 39 and 40 seconds. Read the full transcript: only 'Thank you.' at 4.34–4.64 seconds, uncertain ASR. Full speech is source-derived by the shared renderer from the complete timestamped transcript, never manually excerpted. Panel ranges are derived from successive starts, with the final range ending at the source ffprobe/index duration of 41.288 seconds. Boundaries are approximate editorial groupings, not exact cuts. Fixed compositions and sampled darkening support holds/fades, not camera movement. Eight useful panels omit the redundant 30.030-second hold. The emblem-only 39-second targeted still is described in the final caption because it has no indexed tile. Empty sound arrays mean unannotated audio, not silence. Sparse samples cannot guarantee every brief insert; no soundtrack or additional dialogue is invented.

panels.heading: Black opening
panels.description: The opening image is entirely black. The trailer begins without a city view, character or explanatory scene; the first claim will appear next.
panels.camera: Static full-frame black at indexed 0.000 seconds and targeted 1 second. No pan, tilt or zoom is established.
panels.action: No visible character or gameplay action; black screen.
panels.notes: First text is visible by targeted 2 seconds; its exact onset is unresolved. No audio has been annotated.

panels.heading: Setup: unprecedented trailer claim
panels.description: Centered white capitals on black read 'FOR THE FIRST TIME ON YOUTUBE'. This is a promotional title card, not a subtitle of the ASR line and not verified evidence of novelty.
panels.camera: Fixed centered card at targeted 2 and 4.5 seconds and indexed 5.005 seconds. Text dims by targeted 7 seconds and is gone at 8, supporting a fade out rather than camera motion.
panels.action: Static typography holds, then darkens. No characters are visible.
panels.visualGag: Setup for the mock-grand trailer sequence: an unprecedented-YouTube claim leads into 'TRANSCEND THE BOUNDARIES OF TIME', then eventually the 'SCREEN NEAR YOU' release formula. Its humorous inflation is interpretive, not proof of an objectively first-ever series.
panels.notes: The sole complete ASR segment is 4.34–4.64 seconds. 'Thank you.' is reproduced exactly but is uncertain machine recognition in predominantly non-speech audio; speaker and intelligibility were not independently established. It does not narrate the printed card.

panels.heading: Escalation: boundaries of time
panels.description: White two-line capitals read 'A CITIES SKYLINES SERIES WILL / TRANSCEND THE BOUNDARIES OF TIME'. The card explains the grand promise through text, without showing historical city development or literal time travel.
panels.camera: Fixed two-line composition at indexed 10.010 and targeted 10 seconds; text is dim at targeted 12 seconds and absent at 13, supporting a fade to black. No pan, tilt or zoom.
panels.action: A static card holds and darkens. No gameplay or visible character action.
panels.visualGag: Continuation/payoff of the preceding 'FOR THE FIRST TIME ON YOUTUBE' setup: a city-building series receives sweeping, time-transcending trailer language. The disproportion can read as playful hyperbole; do not turn it into a fictitious time-travel plot. The movie-trailer register also sets up the later 'SCREEN NEAR YOU' wording.
panels.notes: Source description says the series follows city development over time; this is metadata context, not spoken dialogue in this card. Boundaries are approximate; sampled black at 13 precedes the next card.

panels.heading: The educational and entertainment promise
panels.description: Centered white capitals read 'AND EDUCATE AND ENTERTAIN YOU / ALONG THE WAY'. The trailer states its purpose through a third plain text card rather than presenting examples.
panels.camera: Fixed two-line framing at targeted 15 and 17 seconds and indexed 15.015 seconds. The subsequent logo is present by 20 seconds; the intervening transition mechanism is not established.
panels.action: Static text card; no visible character movement or city-building action.
panels.visualGag: Bridge in the same trailer-rhetoric sequence: the time-transcending promise is brought back to education and entertainment before the title and release-date reveal. No separate punchline is established on this card.
panels.notes: Printed wording is observed visual text, not ASR speech. Exact exit time is unresolved.

panels.heading: Title reveal: Franklin
panels.description: A large orange FRANKLIN wordmark, with dark outlined/extruded-looking edges and a cracked bell emblem on its right, appears alone on black. This is the series identity reveal, not a city panorama.
panels.camera: Fixed centered logo at indexed 20.020 seconds and targeted 20 and 23 seconds. No enlargement, pan, tilt or zoom is established by these samples.
panels.action: Static graphic title. No characters are present and the bell is not observed ringing.
panels.visualGag: Title-reveal beat in the preceding hyperbolic trailer setup; the reveal names an ordinary Cities: Skylines series rather than demonstrating literal time travel. The bell is an observed emblem, not independently a gag.
panels.notes: Logo is alone at 23 seconds and has the creator-credit line by 25. No bell sound is inferred from its image.

panels.heading: Creator-credit layer
panels.description: The orange Franklin title remains. Beneath it, white text reads 'A DONOTEAT' and 'SERIES', separated by a round coin-like creator emblem with a reddish diagonal band. The announcement adds authorship as another layer.
panels.camera: Fixed framing. Indexed 25.025 and 30.030 seconds and targeted 25 and 30 seconds show the same credit layout; this is a hold, not a pan or zoom.
panels.action: Static title and creator-credit graphics. The circular mark is not observed spinning or moving.
panels.visualGag: Continuation of the trailer-style buildup: staged name and creator credits prepare the final 'ARRIVING AT A SCREEN NEAR YOU' release-date payoff. No separate coin-action joke is established.
panels.notes: Indexed frame 7 at 30.030 seconds was inspected but omitted as a redundant hold. Tiny lettering on the round emblem is not confidently transcribed.

panels.heading: Payoff: arriving at a screen near you
panels.description: The completed card retains the Franklin title and creator credit and adds 'ARRIVING AT A SCREEN NEAR YOU JUNE 23' across the lower portion. This supplies the release announcement after the escalating promises.
panels.camera: Fixed full-card framing at targeted 33, 35 and 37 seconds and indexed 35.002 seconds. No pan, tilt or zoom; the date line is an added graphic layer, not a camera move.
panels.action: Static completed announcement card holds; no visible characters or gameplay.
panels.visualGag: Payoff to the earlier grand promotional cards and staged credits: 'ARRIVING AT A SCREEN NEAR YOU' adapts the familiar theatrical-release formula to an online Cities: Skylines series. The gag is printed wording and trailer register, not transcribed speech.
panels.notes: The card gives June 23 but no printed year. No separate historical conclusion or gameplay demonstration follows.

panels.heading: Exit: lingering emblem, then black
panels.description: The selected indexed image is fully black at 40.007 seconds. Before this black tail, a targeted still at 39 seconds shows only the round creator emblem in its former credit-line position after all text and the Franklin title have vanished. The trailer ends without another scene.
panels.camera: Framing remains fixed. Targeted 37 seconds shows the complete card, 39 shows only the emblem, and 40 plus indexed 40.007 show black. These samples establish staged disappearance, not a pan, tilt or zoom; exact fade/cut mechanics are unresolved.
panels.action: Title and credit/date text disappear, followed by the remaining emblem. No character action and no established movement of the emblem.
panels.notes: The lingering-emblem exit is observed but not confidently a separate joke. Its actual targeted evidence is visual/Vln5Ri4Zpgo/targeted/at-39.000s.png; there is no indexed emblem-only tile, so this panel honestly uses the black ending frame instead. Audio remains unannotated, not asserted silent.
